title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・もっかい！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan doesn't want to lose. She grits her teeth and desperately hangs in there for the 3,200 meters of the Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Gold Ship tells her to keep on being her dumb self.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unable to read between the lines, Jordan takes offense, but their rivalry will have to wait until the Takarazuka Kinen to be settled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final leg of the Senior Spring Triple Crown will be the perfect stage to unveil her true potential.
